newsitem.title: USA: Iraq seeking 30,000 T U.S. long grain rice - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iraq seeking 30,000 T U.S. long grain rice - trade.

text.p: Iraq was seeking 30,000 tonnes of U.S. long grain rice under a United Nations-monitored oil-for-food deal for October shipment, several U.S. exporters said.
Exporters said Iraq tendered for the rice on Friday and that results were due either late Tuesday or Wednesday.,
The quality tendered for is long grain U.S. No. 3 grade, maximum 10 percent broken milled rice, exporters said.
"Results were due supposedly today," one major U.S. rice exporter said. But another U.S. rice exporter said offers were firm until Wednesday.
The oil-for-food deal, which allows Iraq to sell $2 billion worth of oil over six months, took effect last December and was renewed for another six months on June 8.
